title: Delivery-Failure Buffer for Specialty Transition Supplies (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Buffer.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a specialty transition supply carries a delivery-failure buffer when the member's recent specialty deliveries of the drug failed. The buffer is read from the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program records of reshipped fills and the reship reason recorded on each.

| Replacement shipments of the drug within the reship lookback of **6** months | Buffer added |
|---|---|
| at least one sent because of a temperature excursion | **2** days |
| none for a temperature excursion, but at least one sent because of a missed delivery | **1** day |
| none for either reason | none |

**The lookback.** A replacement shipment is within the lookback when its ship date lies fewer whole months than 6 before the handling date. A shipment exactly 6 whole months back is outside it.

**Priority.** When the lookback holds both kinds of replacement, the temperature-excursion buffer of 2 days applies. The two buffers are never added together.

The buffer is added to the supply's dose-cycle days. Only after that is the supply held between zero and the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 10 September).*
- A temperature-excursion reshipment dated 11 March is 5 whole months back. It is inside the lookback and adds 2 days.
- The same reshipment dated 10 March is 6 whole months back. It is outside the lookback and adds nothing.
- A missed-delivery reshipment dated 2 August, with no temperature-excursion reshipment in the lookback, adds 1 day.
